senses.en: A container with a handle and spout for boiling water.

ex.en: Put the kettle on while I find the cups.
Boiling only the water needed in a kettle can reduce household electricity consumption over time.

col: put the kettle on｜bắc ấm nước lên đun
boil the kettle｜đun một ấm nước
tip: kettle dùng để đun nước, còn teapot dùng để pha trà.

senses.en: A sport using throws and holds to overcome an opponent.

ex.en: Our judo teacher showed us how to fall safely.
Practising judo under qualified supervision can help young people develop balance, self-discipline, and respect for others.

tip: Tập judo dùng do judo, không dùng play judo.

senses.en: completely different, or on the other side
facing someone or something from the other side

senses.zh: điều trái ngược; người đối lập
senses.en: someone or something completely different from another

ex.en: We left the station and walked in opposite directions.
Although the policy aimed to reduce traffic, it had the opposite effect in several residential areas.

col: the opposite effect｜tác dụng ngược lại
the exact opposite｜điều hoàn toàn trái ngược
tip: Giới từ opposite đi thẳng với địa điểm; danh từ thường dùng the opposite of.

senses.en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs.
An animal or person of the female sex.

ex.en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
Encouraging female students to study engineering can help reduce gender inequality in the technology sector.

col: a female elephant｜một con voi cái
tip: Chỉ phụ nữ trưởng thành thường dùng women; female hợp làm định ngữ.

senses.en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind.
Think something is probably true without being certain.

ex.en: Imagine living in a little house beside the sea.
Urban planners must imagine how future residents will use shared spaces before designing new neighbourhoods.

col: imagine doing something｜tưởng tượng việc làm gì
imagine the future｜hình dung tương lai
tip: imagine đi với danh động từ, không đi với to do.

senses.en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers.
To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority.
A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.

ex.en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
Public institutions should store confidential files securely to prevent unauthorized access and protect citizens' personal information.

col: file a complaint｜nộp đơn khiếu nại
tip: file a complaint là nộp đơn khiếu nại chính thức, không phải lưu đơn khiếu nại.

senses.en: A company that transports passengers or goods by aircraft

ex.en: The airline sent us new tickets after cancelling our flight.
Airlines can lower their environmental impact by investing in more efficient aircraft and reducing unnecessary flights.

col: budget airline｜hãng hàng không giá rẻ
tip: airline là hãng hàng không; chuyến bay cụ thể dùng flight.

senses.en: an idea offered for someone to consider
a slight sign that something exists or may be true

ex.en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
The suggestion to expand cycle lanes received strong support from residents concerned about road safety.

col: make a suggestion｜đưa ra gợi ý
a useful suggestion｜một gợi ý hữu ích
a suggestion of｜một chút; chút ít
tip: suggestion là danh từ đếm được; advice thường không đếm được.

senses.en: The area beside the sea, especially where people spend holidays
Located beside the sea, especially in a holiday area

ex.en: We spent the afternoon building sandcastles at the seaside.
Seaside towns often depend on summer tourism, which can create unstable employment for local residents.

col: seaside resort｜khu nghỉ dưỡng ven biển
tip: Danh từ thường dùng the seaside; nói “ở bờ biển” dùng at.

senses.zh: chính chúng ta; bản thân chúng ta
senses.en: used when we are both doing and receiving an action
used to emphasize that we do something, not others

ex.en: We saw ourselves reflected in the clear lake.
By involving ourselves in community projects, we can develop practical skills and strengthen local relationships.

col: by ourselves｜một mình; tự chúng ta
tip: by ourselves có thể là “một mình” hoặc “tự làm, không nhờ ai”.

senses.en: cooked in hot oil or fat

ex.en: We had fried eggs and toast for breakfast.
Eating fried foods too frequently can increase calorie intake and make maintaining a healthy weight more difficult.

tip: fried là quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ của fry, cũng làm tính từ; không chỉ dùng cho đồ chiên ngập dầu.

senses.zh: đề nghị; chủ động đưa ra
senses.en: Say you are willing to give something or do something.

senses.zh: lời đề nghị; lời mời nhận việc hoặc nhận vào học
senses.en: A proposal of help, an opportunity, or a place.
Say how much you are willing to pay.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.

col: offer someone a job｜mời ai nhận việc
accept an offer｜chấp nhận đề nghị
make an offer｜trả giá; đưa ra đề nghị
tip: Chủ động làm việc gì dùng offer to do, không dùng offer doing.

senses.en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics
to arrange things in groups or a particular order
to deal successfully with a problem or practical matter

ex.en: What sort of music do you listen to at home?
Households should sort their waste carefully so that recyclable materials can be processed more efficiently.

col: sort by size｜phân loại theo kích cỡ
sort out a problem｜giải quyết vấn đề
tip: a sort of nghĩa là “một loại”; sort of trong khẩu ngữ nghĩa là “hơi hơi”.

senses.zh: dự án; công trình; đề tài
senses.en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose.
To estimate a future amount or situation using current information.
To send light or images onto a surface.

ex.en: Our garden project started with three pots of herbs.
Researchers project that demand for electricity will increase as more households switch to electric vehicles.

col: a research project｜một dự án nghiên cứu
carry out a project｜triển khai dự án
be projected to rise｜được dự báo sẽ tăng
project an image｜chiếu một hình ảnh
tip: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu, động từ nhấn âm sau.

senses.en: a woman who performs characters in plays or films

ex.en: The actress waved to the crowd outside the theatre.
A successful actress can encourage young people to explore careers in the performing arts.

col: award-winning actress｜nữ diễn viên đoạt giải
tip: actor cũng có thể chỉ nữ; actress nói rõ là nữ diễn viên.

senses.en: Make plans or preparations for something to happen.
Put things in a particular order or position.

ex.en: I arranged to meet my cousin outside the cinema.
Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.

col: arrange a meeting｜sắp xếp cuộc họp
arrange for someone to do something｜sắp xếp để ai làm việc gì
tip: Sắp xếp để ai làm việc gì dùng arrange for sb to do.

senses.en: Liked or enjoyed by many people.
Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.

ex.en: This small café is popular with local students.
Popular science books can encourage public interest in research by explaining discoveries in accessible language.

col: popular with students｜được sinh viên ưa chuộng
tip: Được nhóm người nào ưa chuộng thường dùng popular with hoặc among.

senses.en: Make something work properly or solve a problem.
Attach something firmly in a particular place.
Decide an exact time, price, or arrangement.

ex.en: My neighbour helped me fix the broken kitchen tap.
Governments should fix weaknesses in existing transport networks before investing in expensive new infrastructure.

col: fix a problem｜giải quyết vấn đề
fix something to a wall｜gắn vật gì vào tường
tip: fix có thể là sửa đồ vật, giải quyết vấn đề hoặc ấn định ngày.

senses.en: A container used for rubbish or for storing things.
To throw something away, especially into a rubbish container.

ex.en: Please put the banana skin in the kitchen bin.
Providing a separate bin for food waste can help households recycle more effectively and reduce landfill use.

tip: “Thùng rác” trong tiếng Anh Anh thường là bin, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường là trash can.

senses.en: Cooked using strong direct heat, often on a metal rack.

ex.en: We shared grilled vegetables and warm bread for lunch.
Offering grilled fish alongside plant-based dishes can help school cafeterias provide a wider range of nutritious meals.

tip: grilled nhấn mạnh nướng trực tiếp bằng nhiệt cao.

senses.en: From one side of something to the other.
On the opposite side of, or throughout, an area.

senses.zh: từ bên này sang bên kia; ở đối diện
senses.en: From one side to another, or on the opposite side.

ex.en: We walked across the bridge before the rain started.
Improved internet access allows students across rural regions to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.

col: walk across a bridge｜đi qua cầu
tip: across nhấn mạnh việc băng ngang một bề mặt; through nhấn mạnh đi xuyên qua bên trong.

senses.en: to act in a particular way
to act politely and do what is expected
to work or react in a particular way

ex.en: Our dog behaves calmly when visitors come to the house.
Children often learn how to behave in social situations by observing the adults around them.

col: behave responsibly｜hành xử có trách nhiệm
tip: behave yourself nghĩa là cư xử cho đúng mực, không phải “thể hiện bản thân”.

senses.en: a Southeast Asian country occupying parts of a peninsula and Borneo

ex.en: We explored a rainforest during our holiday in Malaysia.
Tourism in Malaysia creates employment opportunities, but protecting fragile coastal ecosystems remains an important priority.

col: travel to Malaysia｜đi du lịch Malaysia
tip: Tên nước viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không dùng mạo từ the.

senses.en: An outdoor area where cars can be parked.

ex.en: Our car is near the parking lot entrance.
Planting trees around a parking lot can provide shade and reduce surface temperatures during hot weather.

col: empty parking lot｜bãi đỗ xe trống
crowded parking lot｜bãi đỗ xe đông
parking lot entrance｜lối vào bãi đỗ xe
tip: Thường dùng trong tiếng Anh Mỹ; nhà để xe nhiều tầng thường gọi là parking garage.

senses.en: Letters and parcels, or the system used to deliver them.

senses.zh: gửi qua bưu điện; đăng tải
senses.en: To send something by mail or share it publicly.
A job or position in an organisation.

ex.en: A parcel arrived in the post this morning.
Local authorities should post regular updates online to keep residents informed about changes to public services.

col: apply for a post｜nộp đơn xin một vị trí
tip: Với nghĩa gửi thư, tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng post, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng mail.

senses.en: to make something new or bring something into existence
to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop

ex.en: We created a colourful bird from folded paper.
Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.

col: create a problem｜gây ra vấn đề
create a work of art｜sáng tạo một tác phẩm nghệ thuật
tip: create nhấn mạnh việc tạo ra thứ mới, cũng có thể đi với problem với nghĩa gây ra vấn đề.

senses.zh: tổ chức; cơ quan; đoàn thể
senses.en: A group of people working together for a particular purpose.

senses.zh: sự tổ chức; sự sắp xếp
senses.en: The planning and arrangement of activities, people, or things.

ex.en: He joined a local organisation that rescues injured birds.
Effective organisation of healthcare services can shorten waiting times and improve access for rural communities.

col: non-governmental organisation｜tổ chức phi chính phủ
require careful organisation｜đòi hỏi sự sắp xếp kỹ lưỡng
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh thường viết organisation, tiếng Anh Mỹ thường viết organization.

senses.en: To be the right size, shape, or type for something.
Physically healthy and strong, especially through exercise.
Suitable or good enough for a particular purpose.

ex.en: These boots fit perfectly, even with my thick socks.
Public exercise facilities can help older adults stay fit while strengthening social connections within their communities.

col: fit for purpose｜phù hợp mục đích sử dụng
fit in with｜hòa nhập; phù hợp với
tip: Với quần áo, fit nói về kích cỡ vừa; suit thường nói về kiểu dáng hoặc màu sắc hợp.

senses.en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation

senses.zh: trạng thái bình thường; mức bình thường
senses.en: the usual state or level of something

ex.en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
Flexible working hours are becoming a normal feature of employment in many sectors of the economy.

col: return to normal｜trở lại bình thường
normal working hours｜giờ làm việc bình thường
tip: normal nhấn mạnh sự bình thường; ordinary nhấn mạnh tính thông thường, không đặc biệt.

senses.zh: môn bóng chuyền; quả bóng chuyền
senses.en: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.

ex.en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.

tip: Khi chỉ môn thể thao thì không đếm được; play volleyball không có mạo từ.

senses.en: belonging to a period thousands of years in the past
having existed for a very long time

ex.en: We explored an ancient temple during our holiday.
Studying ancient civilisations helps researchers understand how early societies managed water, trade, and public health.

col: ancient civilisation｜nền văn minh cổ đại
ancient monument｜di tích lịch sử cổ đại
tip: ancient nhấn mạnh niên đại rất xa xưa, không nên dùng thay cho old thông thường.

senses.en: How much of something there is.
To total something or be equivalent to it.

ex.en: Add a small amount of milk to the bowl.
Reducing the amount of food wasted by households could significantly lower the environmental impact of food production.

col: a large amount of｜một lượng lớn
total amount｜tổng số lượng; tổng số tiền
amount to｜lên tới; tương đương với
tip: amount of đi với danh từ không đếm được; động từ thường dùng amount to.

senses.en: A photograph you take of yourself, usually with a phone.

ex.en: We took a selfie beside the lake after our walk.
Sharing a selfie online can express personal identity, but users should consider their privacy settings first.

col: take a selfie｜chụp ảnh tự sướng
post a selfie｜đăng ảnh tự chụp
tip: Chụp ảnh tự chụp dùng take a selfie, không dùng make a selfie.

senses.en: To move past something or through a place.
To give something to another person.
To achieve the required standard in an examination or test.

ex.en: We pass a small bakery on our way home.
Students must pass a practical assessment before they can begin working independently in the laboratory.

tip: pass là động từ; past có thể làm giới từ: walk past.

senses.en: a sweet, sticky food made by bees

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.

col: a spoonful of honey｜một thìa mật ong
a jar of honey｜một hũ mật ong
tip: Nghĩa “mật ong” không đếm được; một hũ mật ong nói là a jar of honey.

senses.en: The direction between south and east, or an area's southeastern part.

senses.zh: thuộc đông nam; từ đông nam tới
senses.en: Located in the southeast, or coming from that direction.

senses.zh: về hướng đông nam; ở phía đông nam
senses.en: Towards or in the southeast.

ex.en: Our kitchen window faces southeast and catches the morning sun.
Population growth in the southeast has increased demand for affordable housing and reliable public transport.

col: in the southeast｜ở phía đông nam
southeast of｜ở phía đông nam của
head southeast｜đi về hướng đông nam
the southeast coast｜bờ biển đông nam
tip: Danh từ thường có the; trạng từ không dùng the: head southeast.

senses.zh: kế hoạch; chương trình; khóa học
senses.en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose

senses.zh: chương trình truyền hình hoặc phát thanh
senses.en: a show broadcast on television or radio

senses.zh: lên chương trình; thiết lập cách vận hành
senses.en: to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically

ex.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.

col: launch a programme｜khởi động một kế hoạch
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh dùng programme, chương trình máy tính dùng program; tiếng Anh Mỹ luôn dùng program.

senses.en: trousers with legs ending above or near the knees

ex.en: I packed shorts and sandals for our beach holiday.
In hot weather, lightweight shorts can help people stay comfortable while taking part in outdoor exercise.

col: a pair of shorts｜một chiếc quần short
tip: shorts dùng ở dạng số nhiều; “một chiếc” nói là a pair of shorts.

senses.en: A piece of jewellery worn around the wrist.

ex.en: She wears a silver bracelet that her grandmother gave her.
A handmade bracelet can reflect local artistic traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.

tip: bracelet đeo ở cổ tay; anklet đeo ở mắt cá chân.

senses.en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material.
A group responsible for managing an organisation or making decisions.
Get onto a ship, aircraft, train, or bus.

ex.en: She placed a wooden board across the muddy path.
The board approved a plan to reduce factory emissions without cutting jobs or lowering wages.

col: a wooden board｜một tấm ván gỗ
board of directors｜hội đồng quản trị
on board｜trên tàu hay máy bay
tip: board làm động từ có thể đi thẳng với phương tiện: board a train.

senses.en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others
a person who speaks a particular language
a device that produces sound from electrical signals

ex.en: The speaker made everyone laugh with her opening story.
Inviting a guest speaker from the scientific community can help students understand how classroom knowledge applies to real problems.

tip: a native speaker of English là người nói tiếng Anh bản ngữ.

senses.en: glasses with dark lenses that protect eyes from bright sunlight

ex.en: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.

col: a pair of sunglasses｜một cặp kính râm
put on sunglasses｜đeo kính râm vào
tip: Thường dùng số nhiều; “một chiếc” nói là a pair of sunglasses.

senses.zh: cháu gái (con của anh, chị, em)
senses.en: A daughter of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

ex.en: My niece brought her new puppy to our picnic.
Flexible working hours can help adults care for relatives, including a young niece or nephew.

col: nieces and nephews｜các cháu trai và cháu gái
tip: niece chỉ cháu gái, nephew chỉ cháu trai.

senses.en: Products applied to the face to change or enhance appearance.
The parts or qualities that together form something.

ex.en: She keeps her make-up in a small blue bag.
The social make-up of a neighbourhood can change significantly as new housing attracts different residents.

tip: Danh từ cũng viết là makeup; cụm động từ make up không có dấu gạch nối.

senses.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.

col: attend a concert｜tham dự buổi hòa nhạc
give a concert｜tổ chức buổi hòa nhạc
live concert｜buổi hòa nhạc trực tiếp
tip: Đi xem hòa nhạc dùng go to a concert.

senses.en: Becoming a member of a group or taking part.
Connecting two or more things together.

ex.en: I'm joining a swimming club near my house.
Joining local volunteer groups allows young people to gain practical experience while contributing to their communities.

col: joining a club｜gia nhập câu lạc bộ
joining two pieces together｜ghép hai mảnh lại với nhau
tip: Là dạng -ing của join; gia nhập tổ chức đi thẳng với tân ngữ, không thêm in.

senses.en: Words or actions used when meeting or welcoming someone.
Friendly wishes expressed on a special occasion.

ex.en: She gave us a cheerful greeting at the door.
Learning local greeting customs can help international students build relationships and avoid misunderstandings in their new environment.

col: a warm greeting｜lời chào nồng nhiệt
birthday greetings｜lời chúc mừng sinh nhật
tip: Lời chúc dịp lễ thường dùng số nhiều greetings, như birthday greetings.

senses.en: costing half the usual price
at half the usual price

ex.en: We bought half-price tickets for the afternoon boat trip.
Offering half-price public transport to students could improve access to education and reduce car use.

col: buy something half-price｜mua gì đó với nửa giá
tip: Trước danh từ thường viết half-price; at half price không có dấu gạch nối.

senses.en: in a way that expresses unhappiness

senses.zh: đáng tiếc là; không may là
senses.en: used to express regret about an unfortunate situation

ex.en: He waved sadly as his best friend's train departed.
Sadly, many historic buildings have been demolished to make room for roads and commercial developments.

col: sadly missed｜được nhớ thương sâu sắc
tip: Sadly đứng đầu câu thường nghĩa là “đáng tiếc là”, bổ nghĩa cho cả câu.

senses.en: A spoken or written account giving information about something
To give information about an event or situation
To arrive somewhere and tell the person in charge

ex.en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.

col: report a problem｜báo cáo một vấn đề
report for duty｜trình diện nhận nhiệm vụ
tip: report on đi với chủ đề được đưa tin; report for duty nghĩa là trình diện nhận việc.

senses.zh: vạch qua đường; chỗ băng qua
senses.en: A designated place where people or vehicles cross.

senses.zh: chuyến vượt qua; chuyến sang sông, biển
senses.en: A journey across water or another geographical barrier.

ex.en: We waited at the crossing until the cars stopped.
Installing a pedestrian crossing near every school can help protect children and encourage more families to walk.

col: pedestrian crossing｜vạch qua đường dành cho người đi bộ
level crossing｜chỗ giao cắt đường sắt
tip: Danh từ này có thể chỉ chỗ qua đường, cũng có thể chỉ chuyến đi bằng tàu thuyền để sang bờ bên kia.

senses.en: To put something over a surface or object.

senses.zh: bao gồm; đề cập; đủ trả
senses.en: To include something, deal with it, or pay its cost.
An outer layer that protects or encloses something.

ex.en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
University scholarships should cover living expenses as well as tuition fees for students from low-income families.

col: cover something with｜che vật gì bằng
cover the cost｜đủ chi trả chi phí
cover a topic｜đề cập một chủ đề
tip: cover A with B nghĩa là phủ B lên A; cover chi phí nghĩa là đủ để trả.

senses.en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases
The small, hard ball used in this sport

ex.en: We played baseball in the park after lunch.
Team sports such as baseball can help young people develop cooperation skills and maintain physical fitness.

tip: Tên môn thể thao không đếm được; “một quả bóng chày” nói là a baseball.

senses.en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions.
Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.

tip: So sánh hơn là cleverer, so sánh nhất là cleverest.

senses.en: in, at, or to all places

ex.en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.

col: almost everywhere｜hầu như ở khắp nơi
tip: everywhere là trạng từ, phía trước thường không thêm in hay at.

senses.en: an official document identifying you when travelling between countries

senses.zh: con đường dẫn tới thành công
senses.en: something that makes success or an opportunity possible

ex.en: I checked my bag twice to find my passport.
A university degree is often viewed as a passport to better employment, although practical experience also matters.

col: valid passport｜hộ chiếu còn hiệu lực
renew a passport｜gia hạn hộ chiếu
passport control｜khu kiểm tra hộ chiếu
a passport to success｜tấm vé dẫn đến thành công
tip: Trong nghĩa bóng a passport to, sau to là danh từ.

senses.en: Money in the form of coins and banknotes
Exchange a cheque for money

ex.en: I keep some cash in my wallet for emergencies.
Although digital payments are increasingly common, many small businesses still prefer customers to pay in cash.

col: pay in cash｜trả bằng tiền mặt
cash a cheque｜đổi séc lấy tiền
tip: Nghĩa “tiền mặt” không đếm được; trả bằng tiền mặt là pay in cash.

senses.zh: khăn quàng cổ; khăn choàng đầu
senses.en: Cloth worn around the neck or head.

ex.en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.

col: wrap a scarf around your neck｜quàng khăn quanh cổ
tip: Số nhiều có thể là scarves hoặc scarfs, dạng đầu phổ biến hơn.

senses.en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body
to accept responsibility for something difficult

ex.en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.

col: look over your shoulder｜ngoái đầu nhìn lại
tip: Làm động từ thường đi với responsibility hoặc burden, nghĩa là gánh vác.

senses.en: an appliance that keeps food and drinks cold

ex.en: Put the milk in the refrigerator before it spoils.
Replacing an old refrigerator with an efficient model can reduce household electricity consumption significantly.

col: store food in the refrigerator｜cất thức ăn vào tủ lạnh
tip: Trong khẩu ngữ hay dùng fridge; freezer chỉ riêng tủ đông hoặc ngăn đông.

senses.en: A male royal family member, often a monarch's son.

senses.zh: quốc trưởng của một công quốc
senses.en: A male ruler of a small independent state.

ex.en: The prince waved to visitors from the palace balcony.
In some constitutional monarchies, a prince may support charitable organisations without holding any direct political power.

tip: prince không phải lúc nào cũng là hoàng tử, cũng có thể là thân vương hoặc người đứng đầu một công quốc.

senses.zh: môn đua thuyền buồm; việc đi thuyền buồm
senses.en: The activity of travelling in a boat powered by wind.
A scheduled journey or departure by a ship or ferry.

ex.en: We went sailing on the lake last weekend.
Sailing clubs can encourage outdoor exercise while teaching young people teamwork and respect for marine environments.

col: a sailing club｜câu lạc bộ thuyền buồm
regular sailings｜các chuyến tàu thường xuyên
tip: Nghĩa môn thể thao không đếm được; nghĩa chuyến tàu đếm được, như daily sailings.

senses.en: Coming after the eighth and before the tenth.
One of nine equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our new apartment is on the ninth floor.
By the ninth year of the conservation programme, several endangered species had begun to recover.

col: in ninth place｜ở vị trí thứ chín
one ninth of｜một phần chín của
tip: Từ nine thành ninth thì bỏ e; trước số thứ tự thường dùng the.

senses.en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes.
The basic qualities that make something what it is.
The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.

ex.en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.

tip: Khi chỉ thiên nhiên thường không dùng the; bản chất của việc gì dùng the nature of.

senses.en: to answer someone or respond to a message

senses.zh: câu trả lời; lời hồi đáp
senses.en: an answer given in speech or writing

ex.en: Please reply before Friday so I can book dinner.
Local officials should reply promptly to residents who raise concerns about public transport services.

col: reply to a message｜trả lời tin nhắn
a prompt reply｜một câu trả lời nhanh chóng
tip: reply to đi với người hoặc tin nhắn, không đi thẳng với tân ngữ.

senses.en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals.
A slippery liquid used for cooking, lubrication or other purposes.
To apply oil so that something moves smoothly.

ex.en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
Reducing dependence on oil requires sustained investment in renewable energy and more efficient public transport.

col: oil a hinge｜tra dầu cho bản lề
tip: Thường không đếm được; khi chỉ các loại dầu khác nhau có thể dùng oils.

senses.en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.

ex.en: I added some beans to the vegetable soup.
Beans provide an affordable source of protein and can support a balanced plant-based diet.

col: baked beans｜đậu nướng sốt cà chua
tip: Danh từ đếm được; khi nói chung về đậu ăn thường dùng beans.

senses.en: to be unsuccessful or not do something required
to not pass a test, or give an unsuccessful grade
to stop working properly or become weaker

ex.en: The cake failed to rise despite an extra egg.
Recycling programmes often fail when local authorities do not provide clear guidance or convenient collection services.

col: fail to do something｜không làm được việc gì
fail to meet expectations｜không đáp ứng được kỳ vọng
tip: fail to do nghĩa là không làm được; fail an exam nghĩa là trượt kỳ thi.

senses.zh: giới thiệu; giới thiệu làm quen
senses.en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet.
Bring something into use or a place for the first time.
Help someone experience or learn about something for the first time.

ex.en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
Schools should introduce practical financial education to help students manage money responsibly in adult life.

col: introduce someone to someone｜giới thiệu ai với ai
introduce new measures｜đưa ra biện pháp mới
introduce someone to a subject｜giúp ai làm quen với một môn học
tip: Giới thiệu A với B dùng introduce A to B, không dùng with.

senses.en: someone who dances, especially as a job

ex.en: The dancer spun gracefully across the small stage.
Professional dancers require regular physical training and adequate rest to maintain performance quality and prevent injuries.

col: ballet dancer｜diễn viên múa ba lê
tip: dancer không giới hạn giới tính, cũng không nhất thiết là vũ công chuyên nghiệp.

senses.en: Experiencing bad things because of chance
Believed to bring bad luck

ex.en: We were unlucky to miss the bus by seconds.
Students who are unlucky enough to fall ill during examinations should be offered alternative assessment arrangements.

col: unlucky in love｜không may mắn trong tình yêu
unlucky enough to｜không may đến mức
an unlucky day｜một ngày xui xẻo
tip: unlucky nhấn mạnh vận xui, không giống unhappy (không vui).

senses.en: unable to happen, exist, or be done

senses.zh: cực kỳ khó chiều; khó đối phó
senses.en: extremely difficult to deal with or satisfy

ex.en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.

col: impossible task｜nhiệm vụ không thể hoàn thành
make it impossible to｜khiến không thể làm được
tip: Thường dùng it is impossible to do, nghĩa là không thể làm việc gì.

senses.zh: ở phía trước; về phía trước
senses.en: In front of someone or something, or moving forward.
Further advanced than others or earlier than expected.
In the future, or in preparation for it.

ex.en: Walk straight ahead until you reach the little bridge.
Cities need to plan ahead to ensure that transport networks can meet the demands of growing populations.

col: ahead of schedule｜sớm hơn dự kiến
ahead of the competition｜dẫn trước đối thủ
tip: ahead là trạng từ; khi theo sau là người hoặc vật thì dùng ahead of.

senses.en: bags and cases that hold your belongings when travelling

ex.en: Our luggage barely fitted into the small taxi.
Providing secure luggage storage at railway stations can encourage tourists to explore nearby attractions on foot.

col: a piece of luggage｜một kiện hành lý
luggage allowance｜mức hành lý cho phép
tip: Không đếm được; một kiện hành lý nói là a piece of luggage.

senses.zh: bít tết; miếng thịt; miếng cá
senses.en: A thick slice of meat, especially beef, or fish.

ex.en: She served the steak with potatoes and green beans.
Replacing beef steak with plant proteins occasionally can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.

tip: steak đồng âm với stake; steak đứng một mình thường chỉ bít tết bò.

senses.en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place.
To put things in order and make a place neat.

ex.en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.

col: neat and tidy｜sạch sẽ gọn gàng
tip: tidy nhấn mạnh sự sắp xếp ngăn nắp; clean nhấn mạnh không có bụi bẩn.

senses.en: Sheep's soft hair, or yarn and cloth made from it.

ex.en: This wool scarf keeps my neck warm on windy mornings.
Wool provides natural insulation, making it a useful material for clothing designed for cold climates.

col: a ball of wool｜một cuộn len
tip: Thường không đếm được; một cuộn len nói là a ball of wool.

senses.zh: ví đựng tiền xu; túi xách nữ
senses.en: a small money holder; in American English, a handbag
money available to a person, organisation, or government
to press your lips together into a small rounded shape

ex.en: She opened her purse and took out a coin.
Investment in preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term burden on the public purse.

col: the public purse｜ngân sách nhà nước
tip: Trong tiếng Anh Anh, purse thường là ví nhỏ; trong tiếng Anh Mỹ thường là túi xách nữ.

senses.zh: hoàng hôn; lúc mặt trời lặn
senses.en: the time when the sun disappears below the horizon

senses.zh: cảnh mặt trời lặn; ráng chiều
senses.en: the colourful sky seen as the sun goes down

ex.en: We reached the beach just before sunset yesterday.
Coastal destinations often attract tourists with spectacular sunset views, creating valuable opportunities for local businesses.

col: a spectacular sunset｜một cảnh hoàng hôn tuyệt đẹp
tip: Vào lúc hoàng hôn dùng at sunset, thường không có mạo từ.

senses.en: to become aware of something through your senses
a written statement giving information or instructions
information given before something happens or ends

ex.en: Did you notice the tiny bird outside our window?
Residents often notice improvements in air quality when cities restrict traffic in central areas.

col: notice a difference｜nhận thấy sự khác biệt
at short notice｜báo gấp; thông báo vào phút chót
tip: notice sb do nhấn mạnh toàn bộ hành động; notice sb doing nhấn mạnh hành động đang diễn ra.

senses.zh: Vương quốc Anh; Liên hiệp Vương quốc
senses.en: The country comprising England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

ex.en: We travelled around the United Kingdom by train last summer.
International students in the United Kingdom contribute to university communities through their diverse experiences and perspectives.

col: across the United Kingdom｜khắp Vương quốc Anh
the United Kingdom economy｜nền kinh tế Vương quốc Anh
tip: Phía trước thường có the; bao gồm cả Bắc Ireland, không đồng nghĩa với Great Britain.
note: Tên nước đã được chuẩn hóa viết hoa chữ cái đầu.

senses.en: Used when something is likely but not certain.

ex.en: The bakery will probably close before we get there.
Cities that invest in reliable public transport will probably experience less traffic congestion over time.

tip: Thường đứng trước động từ thường, sau động từ be hoặc sau trợ động từ đầu tiên.

senses.en: Material made by weaving or knitting fibres.
A piece of fabric used for cleaning or covering things.

ex.en: She chose soft cotton cloth for the baby's blanket.
Replacing disposable wipes with reusable cloth can reduce household waste and lower long-term cleaning costs.

col: a piece of cloth｜một mảnh vải
tip: Nghĩa “vải” không đếm được; “giẻ lau” đếm được, số nhiều cloths; đừng nhầm với clothes.

senses.zh: giao thông vận tải; phương tiện đi lại
senses.en: Vehicles or systems used to move people and goods.
To move people or goods from one place to another.

ex.en: We rely on public transport to get around town.
Better transport links between rural areas and cities can expand employment opportunities for local residents.

tip: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu, động từ nhấn âm sau.

senses.en: to fall, let something fall, or become lower

senses.zh: giọt; một lượng nhỏ chất lỏng
senses.en: a very small, rounded amount of liquid
to stop doing or considering something

ex.en: I dropped my keys while reaching for my phone.
If public transport becomes more reliable, the number of people driving to work may drop significantly.

col: a drop of water｜một giọt nước
drop a course｜bỏ một môn học
tip: drop by nghĩa là giảm bao nhiêu; drop to nghĩa là giảm xuống còn bao nhiêu.

senses.zh: chia sẻ; dùng chung; chia nhau gánh
senses.en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others.
One part of something divided among people or groups.
One of the equal units of ownership in a company.

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.

col: share something with someone｜chia sẻ cái gì với ai
tip: Chia sẻ với ai dùng share something with someone.

senses.en: An electric passenger vehicle running on tracks along city streets.

ex.en: We caught the tram outside the library this morning.
Investing in tram networks can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to busy city centres.

col: catch a tram｜bắt kịp xe điện
tip: Chỉ phương tiện chứ không phải đường ray; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng streetcar.

senses.en: A flat paper container used for sending a letter.

ex.en: She slipped the birthday card into a blue envelope.
Although digital communication is widespread, official documents are still sometimes delivered in a sealed envelope for privacy.

col: a sealed envelope｜phong bì đã dán kín
a padded envelope｜phong bì có lót
tip: envelope là “phong bì”; envelop là động từ nghĩa là bao bọc.

senses.en: a tropical bird with a curved beak, sometimes copying speech

senses.zh: nhại lại máy móc; học vẹt
senses.en: to repeat someone's words without understanding or considering them

ex.en: The green parrot cracked a seed with its beak.
Students who merely parrot their teachers' explanations may struggle to apply knowledge to unfamiliar situations.

col: parrot someone's words｜lặp lại máy móc lời ai
tip: Làm động từ thường mang sắc thái chê, nhấn mạnh việc lặp lại mà không hiểu hay suy nghĩ.

senses.en: A water sport using a board with an attached sail.

ex.en: My sister tried windsurfing during our holiday by the lake.
Windsurfing schools can attract visitors to coastal towns, provided that local authorities establish clear water safety guidelines.

col: windsurfing equipment｜dụng cụ lướt ván buồm
windsurfing lessons｜các lớp học lướt ván buồm
tip: windsurfing dùng buồm để tận dụng sức gió; surfing chủ yếu lướt trên sóng biển.

senses.zh: băng qua; vượt qua; giao nhau
senses.en: to go from one side to another, or intersect

senses.zh: hình chữ thập; thập tự giá
senses.en: a shape made by two intersecting lines, or a religious symbol
annoyed or slightly angry

ex.en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.

tip: cross là động từ; across là giới từ hoặc trạng từ.

senses.en: A particular period or step in a process.
A raised area where performers appear before an audience.
To organise and present a performance or public event.

ex.en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.

col: at an early stage｜ở giai đoạn đầu
a stage of development｜một giai đoạn phát triển
stage a play｜dàn dựng một vở kịch
tip: Giai đoạn thường dùng at a stage; trên sân khấu dùng on stage.

senses.zh: về phía trước; về tương lai
senses.en: towards the front or a later time
to send something received to another person or place
an attacking player in sports such as football

ex.en: Please step forward when there is space ahead.
Investment in renewable energy can help countries move forward towards a more sustainable economic future.

col: move forward｜tiến về phía trước; có tiến triển
put forward a proposal｜đưa ra đề xuất
tip: Trong look forward to, to là giới từ, theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: Someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

ex.en: My colleague brought homemade soup to the office today.
Sharing knowledge with colleagues can improve workplace efficiency and help new employees develop essential skills.

col: work colleague｜đồng nghiệp trong công việc
a close colleague｜đồng nghiệp thân thiết
tip: colleague là đồng nghiệp, không nhất thiết là bạn bè hay cùng cấp bậc.

senses.zh: sự bừa bộn; sự lộn xộn
senses.en: A dirty or untidy state or collection of things.

senses.zh: tình trạng rối ren; hỗn loạn
senses.en: A situation full of problems or confusion.
To make something untidy or spoil it, usually with up.

ex.en: The kitchen was a mess after we baked biscuits.
Without clear responsibilities, a community project can quickly become a mess, wasting both time and resources.

col: in a mess｜lộn xộn; bừa bộn
tip: Hay nói make a mess; mess up có thể là làm lộn xộn hoặc làm hỏng việc.

senses.en: A particular standard, amount, or height of something.
Flat and even, or at the same height.

senses.zh: san phẳng; làm cho bằng nhau
senses.en: To make a surface flat or things equal.

ex.en: The water level rose after last night's heavy rain.
Improving the level of public transport can encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.

col: a high level of｜mức độ cao của; lượng lớn
level the playing field｜tạo sân chơi công bằng
tip: at chỉ mức độ đang ở; on the same level có thể chỉ cùng một tầng.

senses.en: At a later time, following an event.

ex.en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.

tip: afterwards là trạng từ, không đi thẳng với tân ngữ; after thì có thể.

senses.en: Containing nothing or having no people inside.
To remove everything from a container or place.
Lacking real meaning, value, or sincere intention.

ex.en: The biscuit tin was empty when I opened it.
Converting empty office buildings into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.

col: empty the bin｜đổ sạch thùng rác
on an empty stomach｜khi bụng đói
tip: empty nhấn mạnh bên trong không có gì; vacant thường dùng cho nhà hoặc vị trí còn trống.

senses.en: To receive money in return for work.
To gain something deserved through your actions or qualities.

ex.en: She earns extra money by walking dogs after school.
Companies can earn public trust by reporting their environmental impact honestly and taking responsibility for their mistakes.

col: earn respect｜giành được sự tôn trọng
earn a reputation｜tạo dựng danh tiếng
tip: earn nhấn mạnh có được nhờ lao động hoặc biểu hiện; win thường dùng khi thắng cuộc.

senses.zh: cuộc phiêu lưu; chuyến mạo hiểm
senses.en: An exciting experience involving uncertainty or possible danger
Willingness to explore unfamiliar or exciting situations

ex.en: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.

col: go on an adventure｜đi phiêu lưu
a sense of adventure｜tinh thần ưa phiêu lưu
tip: adventure đếm được khi chỉ một trải nghiệm cụ thể, không đếm được khi chỉ tinh thần mạo hiểm.
